thread:
maria: deploy-bot just flagged a small but persistent 5xx increase for AcmeCorp on the dedicated-acme pool during the canary. hitting p95 latency + error budget. do we want an automated revert or manual partial rollback/pin? :eyes:

deploy-bot: ALERT: canary-rule: dedicated-acme · 5xx-rate > 1.5% for 3m
```
  sample: {5xx_rate: 2.1%, p95: 320ms, model: v3.5.2, pool: dedicated-acme}
  auto-revert-suggestion: false (threshold met but not global)
  ```

sam: can we narrow to just that dedicated pool? if it's only Acme, a targeted rollback makes sense. avoid global rollback if not necessary.

alex: +1 to targeted. need to confirm whether the change was a model variant or infra kernel flag. @maria any idea what landed in that pool at ~1759990900?

maria: it was the v3.5.2 rollout with new kernel flag `kv-cache-priority=aggressive` (recent canary). rolled to dedicated-acme at 1759990800.

kevin: if it's the kv-cache flag causing regressions for Acme's workload, we should do a partial revert on that pool and pin them to v3.5.1. customers on shared pools stay on v3.5.2. timelines: we can execute manual revert in the next 10m. change window is open.

jen: heads-up — I'll draft a short customer note for Acme: what we changed, why we reverted, and ETA for investigation. keep it simple.

sam: ops commands (for runbook):
```
# verify pool
redwoodctl pool describe dedicated-acme
# rollback that pool only
redwoodctl rollout revert --pool dedicated-acme --to-version v3.5.1 --reason "canary 5xx spike"
# pin version
redwoodctl pool pin --pool dedicated-acme --version v3.5.1
```

alex: I'll watch the rollback and watch alerting (oncall routing). will hold until kevin gives thumbs.

kevin: go for it. I'll trigger the revert now and coordinate with infra if anything blocks. notify customer after we see 10m of stability.

maria: executing revert now. posting progress. :rocket:

deploy-bot: TASK: rollback-started by kevin at 1759991180 · target v3.5.1 · pool dedicated-acme

kevin: rollback finished for dedicated-acme, health checks passing. 5xx rate dropping. monitoring next 15m.

alex: seeing p95 back down to ~110ms, 5xx at 0.2% — good. I'll suppress noisy alerts for this pool for next 20m to avoid escalations.

jen: draft sent to Acme account team, subject line: "Quick revert after canary regression — no customer impact expected". I'll add the rollback time and a short note about next steps.

maria: follow-ups: 1) open ticket for kernel-flag regression (assign sam), 2) update release notes (add known issue + rollback), 3) consider making auto-revert threshold stricter for dedicated pools. I'll create the tickets now.

sam: creating ticket RD-2781 with repro steps and perf traces. tagging release and infra.

maria: thanks all. closing thread once postmortem + release-note patch are live. :thumbsup:
